name: Eraburu ~Erabu + Love x Double de~
original_name: えらぶる～えらぶ＋らぶ×ダブルで～
source:
Main character is a freelance editor. He is forcibly brought as an employee to a company where he needs to edit adult works. With his new female manager he needs to finish each piece with good results. Whether he can find his love at such work or not, depends on the player.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公原本是一名自由编辑，却被强行拉进一家公司入职，负责成人作品的编辑工作。他必须与新任女上司携手合作，出色地完成每一部企划。至于能否在这份工作中收获爱情，一切取决于玩家的选择。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
